using System;

namespace Orleans.Hosting.Tests

        [Fact]

        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var builderMock = new Mock<ISiloBuilder>();
            builderMock.Setup(b => b.ConfigureServices(It.IsAny<Action<IServiceCollection>>()))
                .Callback<Action<IServiceCollection>>(configureAction =>
                {
                    configureAction(services);
                })
                .Returns(builderMock.Object);

            Action<OptionsBuilder<AzureStorageClusteringOptions>> configureOptions = _ => { };

            // Act
            var result = AzureTableClusteringExtensions.UseAzureStorageClustering(builderMock.Object, configureOptions);

            // Assert
            builderMock.Verify(b => b.ConfigureServices(It.IsAny<Action<IServiceCollection>>()), Times.Once());
            Assert.NotNull(result);

            // Verify the factory was registered and exercises GetRequiredService
            var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
            var validator = serviceProvider.GetService<IConfigurationValidator>();
            Assert.NotNull(validator);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void UseAzureStorageClustering_SiloBuilder_OptionsOverload_RegistersMembershipTable()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var builderMock = new Mock<ISiloBuilder>();
            builderMock.Setup(b => b.ConfigureServices(It.IsAny<Action<IServiceCollection>>()))
                .Callback<Action<IServiceCollection>>(configureAction =>
                {
                    configureAction(services);
                })
                .Returns(builderMock.Object);

            Action<AzureStorageClusteringOptions> configureOptions = _ => { };

            // Act
            AzureTableClusteringExtensions.UseAzureStorageClustering(builderMock.Object, configureOptions);

            // Assert
            var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
            var membershipTable = serviceProvider.GetService<IMembershipTable>();
            Assert.IsType<Orleans.Clustering.AzureStorage.AzureBasedMembershipTable>(membershipTable);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void UseAzureStorageClustering_ClientBuilder_OptionsBuilderOverload_CallsGetRequiredService()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var builderMock = new Mock<IClientBuilder>();
            builderMock.Setup(b => b.ConfigureServices(It.IsAny<Action<IServiceCollection>>()))
                .Callback<Action<IServiceCollection>>(configureAction =>
                {
                    configureAction(services);
                })
                .Returns(builderMock.Object);

            Action<OptionsBuilder<AzureStorageGatewayOptions>> configureOptions = _ => { };

            // Act
            var result = AzureTableClusteringExtensions.UseAzureStorageClustering(builderMock.Object, configureOptions);

            // Assert
            builderMock.Verify(b => b.ConfigureServices(It.IsAny<Action<IServiceCollection>>()), Times.Once());
            Assert.NotNull(result);

            // Verify the factory was registered and exercises GetRequiredService
            var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
            var validator = serviceProvider.GetService<IConfigurationValidator>();
            Assert.NotNull(validator);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void UseAzureStorageClustering_ClientBuilder_OptionsOverload_RegistersGatewayListProvider()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var builderMock = new Mock<IClientBuilder>();
            builderMock.Setup(b => b.ConfigureServices(It.IsAny<Action<IServiceCollection>>()))
                .Callback<Action<IServiceCollection>>(configureAction =>
                {
                    configureAction(services);
                })
                .Returns(builderMock.Object);

            Action<AzureStorageGatewayOptions> configureOptions = _ => { };

            // Act
            AzureTableClusteringExtensions.UseAzureStorageClustering(builderMock.Object, configureOptions);

            // Assert
            var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
            var gatewayListProvider = serviceProvider.GetService<Orleans.Messaging.IGatewayListProvider>();
            Assert.IsType<Orleans.Clustering.AzureStorage.AzureGatewayListProvider>(gatewayListProvider);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void UseAzureStorageClustering_SiloBuilder_NullOptionsBuilder_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            var builderMock = new Mock<ISiloBuilder>();
            builderMock.Setup(b => b.ConfigureServices(It.IsAny<Action<IServiceCollection>>()))
                .Returns(builderMock.Object);

            // Act
            var result = AzureTableClusteringExtensions.UseAzureStorageClustering(builderMock.Object, (Action<OptionsBuilder<AzureStorageClusteringOptions>>)null);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void UseAzureStorageClustering_ClientBuilder_NullOptions_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            var builderMock = new Mock<IClientBuilder>();
            builderMock.Setup(b => b.ConfigureServices(It.IsAny<Action<IServiceCollection>>()))
                .Returns(builderMock.Object);

            // Act
            var result = AzureTableClusteringExtensions.UseAzureStorageClustering(builderMock.Object, (Action<AzureStorageGatewayOptions>)null);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(result);
        }
